first_attempt.symptom: The harness rejected non-null hidden_states_scale instead of passing the int8 per-token scale into the W8A8 chain.
first_attempt.fix: Accept the DeepEP INT8 tuple and pass its per-token scale to each local expert group.

second_attempt.cause: The implementation copied W8A8 expert outputs into an empty_like buffer inherited from INT8 dispatch rows; DeepEP combine requires BF16 output rows.
second_attempt.fix: Allocate the combine input as BF16 [received_rows, hidden] and copy each computed main/replica group into it while retaining the original INT8 input scales.
